en: Black‑and‑white view over a forested river or lake system with a small lock or dam in the foreground. A passenger steamboat or motor vessel is passing through the lock along a narrow pier, surrounded by dense coniferous and mixed woodland on rolling hills. The scene looks like a scenic rural waterway, possibly part of a canal with timber structures and calm water, photographed from an elevated vantage point.
